# Version 4.152.0
> **Skia m152 and Graphite** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel reads on the Skia m152 engine. This release also strengthens object lifetime handling, improves package diagnostics, and adds platform assets for Nano Server and Vulkan Silk.NET consumers.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and includes its subsequent servicing, stability, and glyph-handling fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, expanding access to modern GPU rendering APIs. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads** — SKImage and SKSurface gain backend-neutral RequestReadPixels APIs for asynchronous pixel readback. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native lifetime fixes** — Fixes use-after-free and leak paths involving SKRegion span iteration, SKPixmap subset and With* results, SKImage raster creation, and HarfBuzz blob conversion. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Runtime-effect buffers released on reset** — Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the previous uniform buffer instead of retaining it. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower-allocation managed paths** — Improves hot managed operations by avoiding SKData.SaveTo buffer copies, feature-array copying during HarfBuzz shaping, tag string boxing, and repeated uniform lookups. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))

## Platform

- **Expanded native package assets** — Adds FreeType-backed Nano Server font support, restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, and produces Apple native symbol packages. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

HarfBuzzSharp avoids copying caller-provided feature arrays during shaping and fixes the non-memory-backed blob conversion lifetime path.
